title: Turning 18 Legal Docs, IPOs & Cyber Insurance 📜
description: PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, Demat Account at 18, IPO Allotment mechanics, and Personal Cyber Insurance.

cards.title: Essential Docs at 18 Checklist 📄
cards.content:
18 saal ke hote hi yeh 4 documents turant banao:

1. **PAN Card** (Online NSDL e-PAN in 10 mins with Aadhaar OTP).
2. **Bank Account Adult Upgrade** (Minor account ko Major status mein convert karo).
3. **Voter ID Card** (NVSP portal online).
4. **Demat Account** (Zerodha/Groww/AngelOne) investment start karne ke liye.

cards.title: IPO Allotment Mechanics 📈
cards.content:
Retail Individual Investor (RII) quota: **Max ₹2 Lakh application limit**.

Over-subscription lot system: Jab IPO 50x subscribe hota hai, toh allotment **Random Lottery System** se milta hai — ek person ko maximum 1 lot hi milega regardless of total bid amount!
cards.imagePrompt: Lottery wheel with stock market candlestick candles, gold vector

quizData.question: IPO allotment chance badhane ke liye ek hi Demat account se multiple application daal sakte hain?
options: Nahi, same PAN se single application hi valid hogi
quizData.explanation: Multiple bids from same PAN get REJECTED! Different family members ke Demat accounts se bid karna best strategy hai.

cards.content:
